function: Autoencoder jointly learns the OTFS symbol mapper (constellation) and the delay-Doppler demapper that detects the bits, under transmitter and receiver hardware impairments (p. 2, p. 3).
system: OTFS link, no antenna array or RIS described; transmitter and receiver IQ imbalance and DC offset (p. 2); 4 GHz carrier, 15 kHz spacing (p. 4); M=N=8, 32 (p. 5).
method: Autoencoder: fully connected mapper and demapper (three layers each, p. 4), trained jointly offline, supervised end-to-end with cross-entropy on the sent message, Adam, training SNR 10 dB (p. 3).
data_channel: Simulated OTFS link over EVA channel [14] (p. 4), 4 GHz carrier; 100000 random one-hot messages for training, 10000 for testing (p. 3); no public dataset or measurement.
test_conditions: Trained at SNR 10 dB with HIs (p. 3); tested over SNR, 500 and 1000 km/h, HI settings, SE and CSI error (p. 4, p. 5); training speed unstated.
baselines: Classical: MMSE and message passing (MP) detectors; learned: CNN-based OTFS detector [10] (same authors) and HI-agnostic autoencoder AE-OTFS [13] (p. 4).
metrics: Bit error rate versus SNR (p. 4); learned constellation points plotted (p. 5).
complexity: Table I (p. 4): order O(N^3 M^3 + KQNM) for AE and CNN versus O(N^3 M^3) for MMSE and O(n_itr N M S |A|) for MP.
openness: none (p. 5: no code or data link given).
q1_support: p. 4: "in the EVA channel [14] with HIs" - EVA is a standardized profile (3GPP TS 36.101) but the paper names no standard; training channel is stated only as the effective channel H_eff (p. 3).
q2_support: p. 3: "training SNR is kept at 10dB" - tests sweep SNR and CSI error; speed, HI settings, frame size and SE are varied without saying a model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 4: "conventional OTFS with MMSE, message passing (MP) and" CNN [10] detectors; p. 4: "conventional AE-OTFS [13]" - BER compared with non-learned and earlier learned methods.
q4_support: p. 4: "on the linear product of number of fully connected (FC) layers" - Table I (p. 4) gives O(N^3 M^3 + KQNM) for the proposed AE.
q5_support: p. 3: "of one-hot vectors, representing the messages, are randomly" generated - data are simulated, and no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset is given.
notes: Area 4: the learned mapper and demapper detect symbols in the delay-Doppler domain of OTFS. q1 is marked met on the EVA profile (another standardized model, 3GPP TS 36.101), which the paper cites only through [14] without naming the standard, and the training channel is not named explicitly, so the reviewer should confirm. q2 is 0 because the paper never states a train and test mismatch for speed (p. 4, Fig. 5), HI parameters (Fig. 4), frame size or SE (p. 5, Fig. 6 and Fig. 8); the HI-agnostic AE trained without HIs and tested with HIs (p. 4, Fig. 3) is the baseline, not the proposed model. Fig. 3 legend labels the HI-agnostic AE as [10], the text as [13].
